# Delawala Marketing — HVAC Division

> Delawala Marketing is a specialized HVAC marketing agency based in Barrie, Ontario, Canada. We help HVAC contractors in Barrie and Simcoe County book 8–12 furnace, AC, and heat pump installs every month using Google Ads, Local Services Ads, Local SEO, and marketing automation. We work exclusively with heating, ventilation, and air conditioning businesses — not generalist home services — and offer month-to-month plans after a 90-day initial term.

## Who we serve

Delawala Marketing works exclusively with HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) contractors. Our ideal client is an established HVAC business in Barrie or Simcoe County with $1M–$5M in annual revenue, 2–10 service technicians, and a desire to grow installs (furnaces, central air conditioning, heat pumps, water heaters) rather than rely on referrals or HomeStars.

We do not work with: plumbing-only businesses, electrical-only businesses, general contractors, residential cleaning, junk removal, handymen, or any non-HVAC home service trades.

## What we do

We provide four core services for HVAC contractors:

1. **Local Services Ads (LSA)** — Setup, Google verification, badge management, and ongoing optimization of Google Local Services Ads. We help HVAC businesses earn the Google Verified badge, which appears at the top of Google search results above traditional ads.

2. **Google Ads management** — Search and Performance Max campaigns targeting high-intent HVAC keywords like "furnace repair Barrie," "AC installation near me," "heat pump Ontario," and rebate-related searches (Greener Homes, HER+, Home Renovation Savings Program).

3. **Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization** — Service-area pages, citation building, review management, GBP posts, and content optimization to rank for "HVAC Barrie," "furnace repair Simcoe County," and surrounding service-area searches.

4. **Marketing automation** — Review-generation automation (auto-text customers after every job), missed-call text-back to recover after-hours leads, maintenance plan funnels, rebate landing pages, and CRM integration with platforms like ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and FieldEdge.

## Plans and pricing

All plans go month-to-month after a 90-day initial term. No long contracts. Ad spend (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Local Services Ads) is paid directly to the platforms and is separate from management fees.

- **Foundation — $1,500 CAD/month + $2,500 setup.** For HVAC shops just getting found online. Lead target: 4–6 qualified leads per month. Includes Google Business Profile optimization, Local Services Ads setup and management, review automation, missed-call text-back, and monthly reporting.

- **Growth — $4,500 CAD/month.** Most popular plan. For established shops ready to grow installs. Lead target: 8–12 qualified leads per month. Includes everything in Foundation plus Google Ads management for furnace, AC, and heat pump campaigns, three conversion-focused landing pages, a rebate funnel for Greener Homes and HER+ programs, and weekly check-ins.

- **Scale — $7,500 CAD/month.** For multi-truck operations dominating Simcoe County. Lead target: 15–25 qualified leads per month. Includes everything in Growth plus Local SEO with monthly content, Meta Ads for retargeting and rebate campaigns, full CRM and maintenance plan automation, bi-weekly strategy calls, and a dedicated account lead.

Recommended ad spend ranges from $1,500 to $5,000 per month depending on plan and service area.

## How we work

Our engagement process has four steps:

1. **Free 20-minute audit.** We screen-share your Google Business Profile, Local Services Ads setup, website performance, and competitor positioning in Barrie and Simcoe County. You leave with three to five specific fixes you can act on, even if you never hire us.

2. **Custom 90-day plan.** We map out which campaigns to run, what budget you need, and what leads to expect.

3. **Launch in 14 days.** We build the landing pages, set up Local Services Ads, configure Google Ads, and turn on automation.

4. **Leads in week 3.** Most Growth-tier clients see their first booked job from our work within 21 days of launch.

## What makes us different

- **HVAC specialization, not generalist marketing.** We understand HVAC buyer behaviour, Ontario rebate programs (Greener Homes, HER+, Home Renovation Savings Program), seasonal demand cycles, and platforms HVAC customers actually use to find contractors. We know furnace install cost-per-lead in Ontario runs $80–$150 on Local Services Ads, that AC install booking rates average 24%, and that maintenance plan members deliver 2.3× the lifetime value of one-off customers.

- **Local to Barrie and Simcoe County.** We understand cottage-country seasonality, the Lake Simcoe region's specific demand patterns, and which Simcoe County rebate programs your customers ask about most.

- **No long contracts.** Month-to-month after a 90-day initial term. 30 days written notice to cancel. No exit fees.

- **No vanity metrics.** We report on booked jobs and qualified leads, not impressions or clicks.

- **You keep what we build.** All websites, ad accounts, CRM data, and automations remain your property if you ever leave.

## Frequently asked questions

**Why HVAC only?** Generalist agencies learn HVAC buyer behaviour on the client's dime. We've already studied it — rebate programs, seasonal cycles, customer search intent, and platform-specific cost-per-lead benchmarks for Ontario.

**Do you guarantee leads?** No honest agency guarantees a specific lead number. Too many variables affect outcomes (service area, pricing, response time, reviews, season). We do guarantee transparent monthly reporting, no long-term lock-in after the 90-day initial term, and a documented playbook.

**How long until leads come in?** Local Services Ads and Google Ads typically produce qualified leads within 2–3 weeks of launch. Local SEO compounds over 3–6 months. Most Growth-tier clients see their first booked job within 21 days of launch.

**Do I need a new website?** Not always. If your current site converts well, we'll build dedicated landing pages for ad campaigns. If it loads slowly or isn't mobile-friendly, we'll recommend a rebuild during the audit.

**What's the difference between Google Ads and Local Services Ads?** Local Services Ads appear at the very top of Google search results with a Google Verified badge — you only pay when a customer calls or messages. Google Ads gives more control over keywords, landing pages, and copy, but charges per click. Most HVAC shops should run both.

**What happens on the audit call?** Twenty minutes, no pitch deck. We screen-share your Google Business Profile, Local Services Ads, website, and competitors. You leave with three to five specific fixes.

**Can I cancel?** Yes. After the 90-day initial term, all plans are month-to-month with 30 days written notice. No exit fees.

## Industry context and key statistics

- The Canadian HVAC market is approximately CAD $12.2 billion in 2025, growing at 5.2% CAGR (source: Mordor Intelligence).
- Approximately 41.4% of Canadian plumbing and HVAC firms are based in Ontario.
- Ontario leads Canada in cold-climate heat pump installations, with roughly 101,540 government-backed installs.
- HVAC maintenance plan customers retain at 89% versus 42% for one-off customers, delivering 2.3× higher customer lifetime value (source: CallJolt 2026 benchmarks).
- Average HVAC cost-per-lead on Google Local Services Ads is approximately $80; Google Ads non-branded search averages $149.
- Canadian customers now require an average of 5.5 touchpoints to convert (up from 4.9), making automation and follow-up systems essential.
